ask: A CRM for our sales pipeline: companies, deals and contacts. The agent drafts follow-ups when a deal goes quiet for a week; I approve every email before it sends.
name: CRM

data.line: Deal · name, company, stage (Lead → Won/Lost), amount, close date, owner, last touch

automation.line: Weekdays 9:00 · deals quiet 7 days → draft a follow-up, you approve before it sends

screens.line: Deals · list and board by stage, deal in the panel
Companies · list with open deals and contacts
Contacts · list by company with email and owner

agent.line: CRM agent · drafts follow-ups, updates deals, answers pipeline questions
